newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in bond auction - NBS.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in bond auction - NBS.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry rejected all bids in an auction of an unspecified tranche of one-year government bonds, a statement issued by the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Tuesday.
The NBS statement did not give further details.
Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
The bonds were to carry an 8.5-percent annual coupon and have a minimum price of par.
In the last successul auction of similar bonds on August 20, the ministry accepted all bids, totalling 6.12 billion crowns, with the average accepted yield at 8.94 percent.
